lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately 9-10 visible longitudinal rows. Spot diameter decreases and density increases towards the dorsal ridge and the posterior caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity create a grid-like pattern, with primary spot centroids positioned at the intersections of these vertical bands and horizontal alignment axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal carinae are visible on the upper flank. They exhibit a sharp horizontal transition from high-intensity light on the superior edge to deep shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 7-9 high-luminance spots are distributed across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated in the central and posterior regions of the fin's macro-mask.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora (Echeneidae) is attached to the ventral-lateral flank, appearing as a distinct elongated dark silhouette with a lighter ventral surface, located below the mid-lateral spot rows.
